name: lead-code
description: Prospect marketing, build plan § 7d.5 (rulings 71-75, 10-22-26): the lead identifier in every link. One code per person for life, held on the lead (CProspect.leadCode, stored as typed - custom entity) and on the contact (Contact.cLeadCode - typed leadCode, prefixed because Contact is not custom), copied from the lead to the contact at promotion. The touch records a click beside a scan. Additive only. None of these fields may be Read-only: the application writes them under the org-wide API key (ruling 40); staff are kept off the two code fields by field rule (scripts/migrate_outreach_roles.py). No index: 'index' is not a Field Manager parameter for varchar (coutreach-entities-crm-handoff.md item (e)). Handoff: lead-code-crm-handoff.md.

fields.name: leadCode
fields.label: Lead code
fields.tooltipText: The code at the end of this lead's personal links (/c/<link>/<code>). Written by the application, the same on every campaign. Never edit by hand: use New code in Campaign Management. Copied to the contact when the lead is promoted.

fields.name: leadCode
fields.label: Lead code
fields.tooltipText: The code at the end of this person's personal links (/c/<link>/<code>). Written by the application; equal to the lead's code when the contact came from a lead. Never edit by hand: use New code on the contact's record page.

fields.name: firstClickedAt
fields.label: First clicked at
fields.tooltipText: When the person first opened their personal link from an email, a text or a call follow-up. Written once by the application. A click alone changes no status (ruling 51).

fields.name: clickCount
fields.label: Click count
fields.tooltipText: How many times the person's personal link was opened for this campaign. Written by the application.
